chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Sinan, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
"Be selective and take care regarding shrouds, for indeed you will be resurrected in them."

key_terms.الْأَكْفَانِ: The burial shrouds in which the dead are wrapped
key_terms.بِهَا: With them; i.e., with those shrouds
key_terms.تُبْعَثُونَ: You will be resurrected and raised again

ai.seo_question: Why should a believer take care in choosing a burial shroud according to hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers to show care and refinement in choosing the kafan (shroud). It connects burial preparation with the reality of resurrection, reminding the believer that matters associated with death carry ongoing significance in the afterlife.
